Massillon, Ohio

Welcome to the Hall of Fame Snubs House

This house is our tongue-in-cheek tribute to the football legends who are not in the Hall of Fame, at least not yet. We are not affiliated with the actual Pro Football Hall of Fame, but from Massillon, Ohio, we are close enough to make the joke work. Between the pool, the cinema, the gym, and the spa bathroom, this house is built for groups who came to play. We hope you create some new stories of your own during your stay.

Matthew, Paulinha, Koa and Rio

03

Amenities

Kitchen and coffee

Fuel for the next play

The kitchen is normal and fully equipped, with a gas stove. The coffee station has a standard 12-cup drip maker.

We set out Pilao ground coffee for guests, which is what my Brazilian in-laws swear by, so we put it in all of our houses. A decaf option is there too. You will find EmergenC in the coffee area in case anyone could use an immune boost after rough travels.

Cinema

Kickoff the movie

The movie theater runs on a Yaber projector with an Amazon Fire Stick connected and Echo Studio speakers. Turn the projector on with the black Yaber remote.

No Amazon menus? Swap the projector source to HDMI 1.

Spa bathroom

Rain, jets, and spa jams

The spa bathroom is one of the best rooms in the house. The walk-in shower has multiple settings between rain flow, handheld, and wall jets, all adjusted from the upper nozzle above the one that controls temperature.

The rainflow head has a built-in light that is blue when the water is cold, green when it is warm, and red when it is hot. One more quirk: the overhead fixture doubles as a Bluetooth speaker, so turn your Bluetooth on, search for devices while you are in there, and put your relaxing spa jams on.

Gym and game room

Put your name on the board

The garage game room and gym has arcade games, weights, and fitness equipment. We keep a series of house leaderboards and we love for guests to try to get on them: the arcade basketball board, the Iron Grip dead hang record board, and the shuttle run, which is 10 trips down and back on our 5-meter turf.

04

Good to Know

Hot tub and pool

Set to soak

The hot tub stays on at 101F and can go up to 104F. Guests never need to shut the tub off when they leave, it always stays on.

Cooler than expected? It was likely reset to vacation or econ mode by mistake. Switching the mode back to standard fixes it. Reach out with any doubts and we will help.

The in-ground pool is open April through September.

Heating and cooling

Comfort by room

The ecobee thermostat is used for heat only. In the summer months, the A/C runs on the individual wall and portable units in each of the rooms, and each one adjusts on its own unit.

Gridiron Guest Hall of Fame

The Hall of Fame Gallery dining room doubles as our jersey wall and a ping-pong space. We invite every guest to join our Gridiron Guest Hall of Fame: share your game-worn jersey from any level along with a picture from your playing days, and you will be forever enshrined in Canton, or close by anyway.

Outdoors

Long evenings outside

Outside you will find a grill, a fire pit, and a backyard hangout built for long evenings.

Before coming in for the night: please turn off the exterior string lights.

Local Recommendations

Our favorite Massillon and Canton stops, all a short drive from the house. Hours and game day schedules can change, so call ahead when timing matters.

Matt's Picks

My own favorites. These are the places I point friends and family to first, and the ones I keep going back to myself whenever I am in Massillon or Canton. Look for the Matt's pick badge on a couple of longtime favorites in the lists below too. Matt
Matt's pick

Chloe's Diner

112 1st St NE, Massillon, OH

A 1950s style diner known for its famous sliders and thick milkshakes, with vintage cars and memorabilia throughout. In the summer there are cruise-in car shows out front. It is an experience.

Matt's pick

Social at the Stone House

824 Lincoln Way E, Massillon, OH

Upscale fusion dining in an 1800s historic home with craft cocktails, from the same owners as Chloe's Diner. It is equally an experience, just upscale dining instead.

Matt's pick

Old Carolina Barbecue Company

2482 Lincoln Way E, Massillon, OH and 4710 Everhard Rd NW, Canton, OH

Carolina style slow smoked barbecue with pulled pork, ribs, brisket, and hush puppies. I stop at one of the nearby Old Carolina locations whenever I am through Massillon or Canton.

Restaurants

Veteran owned downtown bistro in a renovated 150 year old building with stone hearth pizza, house made soups, steaks, and handcrafted cocktails.

Football and Sports Attractions

Pro Football Hall of Fame

2121 George Halas Dr NW, Canton, OH 44708

The shrine of pro football with the bronze bust gallery, Lombardi Trophy photo op, Super Bowl rings, and the A Game for Life theater.

Paul Brown Tiger Stadium

1 Paul E Brown Dr SE, Massillon, OH

The 16,884 seat high school stadium named for Paul Brown, home of the Massillon Tigers and one of the most famous high school venues in America.

Massillon Museum

121 Lincoln Way E, Massillon, OH

Free admission museum with the Paul Brown and Massillon Tiger Football History Timeline, Tiger archives, and rotating local exhibits.

Tom Benson Hall of Fame Stadium

1835 Harrison Ave NW, Canton, OH

Stadium complex next to the Hall of Fame that hosts the annual Hall of Fame Game, concerts, and events at Hall of Fame Village.

Family and Outdoor Activities

Sippo Lake Park

5300 Tyner St, Canton, OH 44708 and 5712 12th St NW, Canton, OH 44708

300 acre Stark County park with a 99 acre lake, paved walking trails, an accessible fishing pier, and seasonal boat and kayak rentals.

The Exploration Gateway at Sippo Lake Park

5712 12th St NW, Canton, OH 44708

Library and nature center inside Sippo Lake Park with exhibits, a wildlife observation deck, story walk, playground, and gift shop. Admission is free.

Sluggers & Putters

333 Lafayette Dr, Canal Fulton, OH 44614

Classic family sports park with mini golf, batting cages, and go karts. Hours are seasonal, so confirm before visiting.

Gervasi Vineyard Grounds

1700 55th St NE, Canton, OH

Free to wander vineyard grounds with walking paths, a lake, and vineyard views. Pair a stroll with lunch or dinner at the Bistro.

Practical

Walgreens Pharmacy

110 Lincoln Way W, Massillon, OH

Closest full pharmacy, about 0.7 miles from the house, open daily 8 AM to 10 PM. CVS at 1130 Lincoln Way E is another close option.

WellNow Urgent Care

1111 Lincoln Way E, Massillon, OH 44646

Nearest urgent care, about half a mile from the house, for colds, flu, sinus issues, rashes, and minor injuries. Walk in hours roughly 7 AM to 7 PM daily.

Check-out

A few things our cleaners appreciate, not a chore list. If you are short on time, do not worry about any of this.

  1. Leave beds unmade, no need to strip them.
  2. Put used towels in the shower.
  3. Load and start the dishwasher.
  4. Empty the trash.
  5. Return furniture and items to their places.
  6. Set the climate controls appropriately.
  7. Lock the doors and windows.

Thank you for staying with us at the Snubs House

We hope the Snubs House gave you a few stories worth retelling. Come back anytime.
